evals.name: classic-eight-game-slate
evals.prompt: Here are my DraftKings files for today's early MLB slate. Generate lineups for all my entries.
evals.expected_output: A certified DKEntries CSV in outputs/<date>/ with every reserved entry filled, all three gates passing, plus a short brief covering gates, slate clock, pool and stacks.

evals.name: showdown-single-game
evals.prompt: Build my lineups for this MIN/CHC showdown, I've got the salary and entries files here.
evals.expected_output: A filled Showdown DKEntries CSV (CPT + 5 UTIL per entry) with the DK template preserved, reported as review-grade rather than certified because Showdown does not pass through the three certification gates (workflow_valid, selection_certified, allocation_certified).

evals.name: classic-under-deadline
evals.prompt: First pitch is in about 20 minutes and I haven't built anything yet. Salary and entries CSVs are attached, I need something I can upload.
evals.expected_output: A certified file produced quickly, skipping optional steps, with the delivery deadline surfaced and no player pool trimming used to save time.
